t: The Fortress Trade 9" Long Pile Microfibre Roller Sleeve is engineered for efficient paint application on various surfaces. This durable roller sleeve is ideal for trade professionals and serious DIYers tackling medium to rough wall and ceiling surfaces, providing a reliable finish for painting projects. The microfibre mix ensures excellent paint loading and release, reducing splatter for a cleaner job. Closed fibres contribute to a smooth and even texture, and the thermobonded fabric construction minimises lint loss, ensuring a high-quality finish every time. This versatile sleeve is suitable for multi-purpose paint applications.
b: Closed Fibres for Smooth Even Texture
Thermobonded Fabric Delivers Minimal Lint Loss
